data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Admins must re-configure their SSO integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Refer to the v4.2 release notes for detailed steps. [T-2074] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
